purpose: The CMU MicroDuck's current measured condition, as far as the simulation needs it. Copied from the private microduck-sim/CURRENT-STATE.json (the robot's single source of current facts, checked against the newest real run on Shawn's Mac). simcheck/sim_suite.py turns these into brain_sim_check.py flags for its 'real' cases. Never edit by hand on the fork: update CURRENT-STATE.json from a measurement, then copy.

servo_rail_v.meaning: Servo supply while walking on the 2S battery backpack (median 7.6 V over the 2026-11-02..11-06 walks and turns, 7.2-8.2 V). The sim holds the supply constant at this value (--volt).

before.why: XL4015 bench rail; the robot now runs on the battery

imu_rate_hz.meaning: IMU samples reaching the policy loop: a new frame on every tick (99.7-100 % of ticks, robot logs 2026-11-02..11-06). No IMU hold in the real cases (--imu-hz 0). The robot's loop itself runs 46-49 ticks/s, not exactly 50.

imu_added_delay_ms.meaning: No delay beyond the normal pipeline (about 15 ms end to end plus half a 50 Hz period). The 40-60 ms trunk lag seen in logs is plant softness, not the IMU (--sensor-delay 1 tick as trained).

servo_read_drop_fraction.meaning: Fraction of 20 ms walk ticks without a fresh servo sync read while the legs step; the policy skips those ticks and the servos hold the last goals (--drop 0.036). 3.3-4.3 % on the five newest robot logs, 2026-11-02..11-06.

walking_policy.value: walk61.onnx (Pollen BEST_alpha_walking) at 0.25 m/s, 3-4 s walks; KP_RL 200 walking, KP 400 in open-loop stand mode
candidates: whole/runtime-overlay/models-ft3-it999 (ft3 iteration 999): better in the sim, lost balance at 2.5-4 s in three of three robot walks at 0.20 m/s on 2026-10-17/18

sole.value: wrapped anti-slip sheet over the printed foot (template cmu/model/sole/sole_template.py); the 2026-10-18 runs used sandpaper on 0.5 mm foam tape
sole.meaning: Foot friction stays inside Pollen's training range (mu 0.7-1.3, PU sole on the official duck); the stack thickness does not change walking in the sim up to 5 mm (cmu/model/sole/README.md).

sim_real_condition: A 'real' suite case takes --volt from servo_rail_v, --drop from servo_read_drop_fraction, an IMU hold only if imu_rate_hz < 49 and an extra sensor delay only if imu_added_delay_ms > 0. Harsher settings are 'stress' cases: report them, never accept or reject a policy on them.
